answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can implement a computational Proof of Work mechanism where minting a valid cryptographic identity requires executing a hard algorithmic search resembling the extraction of a rare opal or an iridescent pearl from a dense matrix. By anchoring network validation rights to a scarce, energy-intensive resource analogous to processing ferrous raw materials, the protocol imposes prohibitive compute costs on an attacker attempting to spawn millions of fake agents, thereby securing decentralized consensus against Sybil infiltration.
